input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "PUB011",
  "title": "Automated Production Line Control",
  "difficulty": "medium",
  "requirements": "# Automated Production Line Control\n\n- **Difficulty:** Medium (medium)\n\n## Requirements\n\nA simple automated production line consists of three workstations: Workstation A, Workstation B, and Workstation C. The product needs to go through these three stations in sequence to be considered fully completed. There is a motor in the production line that is responsible for moving the product from one workstation to the next. The sequence of the line is from Workstation A to Workstation B, and then to Workstation C. Each workstation has a sensor (used to detect if the product has arrived) and a button (used to trigger the signal that the station's processing is complete).\nControl requirements:\n1. Mode Switching: The mode switch (Mode) is used to switch between manual and automatic modes of the production line.\n2. Manual Mode: In manual mode, the forward rotation button (ForwardButton) controls the forward rotation of the motor, and the reverse rotation button (ReverseButton) controls the reverse rotation of the motor. Forward and reverse rotation operations need to be interlocked and cannot be performed simultaneously.\n3. Automatic Mode:\n   - When the product arrives at Workstation A, SensorA detects the product, and after the operator triggers the processing complete signal via ButtonA, the motor starts forward rotation to move the product to Workstation B.\n   - When the product arrives at Workstation B, SensorB detects the product, the motor stops, and after the operator triggers the processing complete signal via ButtonB, the motor starts forward rotation to move the product to Workstation C.\n   - When the product arrives at Workstation C, SensorC detects the product, the motor stops, and after the operator triggers the processing complete signal via ButtonC, the completion indicator light (CompletionLight) turns on, indicating that the product processing is complete. When the product is taken away, i.e., SensorC no longer detects the product, the completion indicator light (CompletionLight) turns off.\n\n## Interface Definition\n\n| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |\n| --- | --- | --- | --- |\n| Input | `Mode` | `BOOL` | Used to switch the production line between manual and automatic modes, 0=manual mode, 1=automatic mode |\n| Input | `ForwardButton` | `BOOL` | Forward rotation button |\n| Input | `ReverseButton` | `BOOL` | Reverse rotation button |\n| Input | `SensorA` | `BOOL` | Sensor A |\n| Input | `SensorB` | `BOOL` | Sensor B |\n| Input | `SensorC` | `BOOL` | Sensor C |\n| Input | `ButtonA` | `BOOL` | Button A |\n| Input | `ButtonB` | `BOOL` | Button B |\n| Input | `ButtonC` | `BOOL` | Button C |\n| Output | `MotorForward` | `BOOL` | Motor forward rotation output |\n| Output | `MotorReverse` | `BOOL` | Motor reverse rotation output |\n| Output | `CompletionLight` | `BOOL` | Indicator light for product processing completion |",
  "scenario": "A conveyor shares manual interlocking and an automatic three-station route.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Mode",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Used to switch the production line between manual and automatic modes, 0=manual mode, 1=automatic mode"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ForwardButton",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Forward rotation button"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ReverseButton",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Reverse rotation button"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "SensorA",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Sensor A"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "SensorB",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Sensor B"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "SensorC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Sensor C"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ButtonA",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Button A"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ButtonB",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Button B"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "ButtonC",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Button C"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "MotorForward",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Motor forward rotation output"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "MotorReverse",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Motor reverse rotation output"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "CompletionLight",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Indicator light for product processing completion"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "MotorForward": false,
    "MotorReverse": false,
    "CompletionLight": false,
    "phase": "WAIT_A"
  },
  "scan_semantics": "Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Forward and reverse are mutually exclusive.",
    "Destination arrival stops movement before processing resumes."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Opposing manual buttons produce neither direction.",
    "Buttons are level signals accepted only in their corresponding station wait. One phase transition is accepted per call.",
    "Entering manual mode clears automatic state and completion; return to automatic waits for A.",
    "Only one product is presented; station sensors are not contradictory.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "auto": "Mode",
    "fwd": "MotorForward after scan",
    "rev": "MotorReverse after scan",
    "mf": "ForwardButton AND NOT ReverseButton",
    "mr": "ReverseButton AND NOT ForwardButton",
    "arrive": "pre-phase MOVE_AB AND SensorB OR pre-phase MOVE_BC AND SensorC",
    "finish": "pre-phase WAIT_C AND SensorC AND ButtonC",
    "light": "CompletionLight",
    "removed": "NOT SensorC",
    "Mode": "I[k].Mode: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ForwardButton": "I[k].ForwardButton: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ReverseButton": "I[k].ReverseButton: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "SensorA": "I[k].SensorA: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "SensorB": "I[k].SensorB: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "SensorC": "I[k].SensorC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ButtonA": "I[k].ButtonA: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ButtonB": "I[k].ButtonB: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "ButtonC": "I[k].ButtonC: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "MotorForward": "O[k].MotorForward: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "MotorReverse": "O[k].MotorReverse: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "CompletionLight": "O[k].CompletionLight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.phase=\"WAIT_A\", O_init.MotorForward=false, O_init.MotorReverse=false, O_init.CompletionLight=false.",
    "phase_wait": "post-phase is WAIT_A, WAIT_B, or WAIT_C",
    "phase_move": "post-phase is MOVE_AB or MOVE_BC",
    "wait_phase": "post-phase is WAIT_A, WAIT_B, or WAIT_C",
    "move_phase": "post-phase is MOVE_AB or MOVE_BC",
    "done_phase": "post-phase is DONE"
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P1",
      "name": "Interlock",
      "formula": "G(!(fwd & rev))",
      "explanation": "Motor directions are mutually exclusive.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P2",
      "name": "Manual",
      "formula": "G(!auto -> ((fwd <-> mf) & (rev <-> mr)))",
      "explanation": "Manual level requests obey neutral conflict resolution.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P3",
      "name": "Auto direction",
      "formula": "G(auto -> !rev)",
      "explanation": "Automatic routing only moves forward.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P4",
      "name": "Arrival",
      "formula": "G(auto & arrive -> !fwd)",
      "explanation": "Arrival stops the motor in the observed scan.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P5",
      "name": "Completion",
      "formula": "G(auto & finish -> light)",
      "explanation": "C completion asserts the light.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P6",
      "name": "Removal",
      "formula": "G(auto & removed -> !light)",
      "explanation": "Removal clears completion.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "PUB011.P7",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "G(auto -> ((move_phase -> (fwd & !rev & !light)) & (wait_phase -> (!fwd & !rev & !light)) & (done_phase -> (!fwd & !rev & light))))",
      "description": "In automatic mode, WAIT_A/B/C keeps all outputs off, MOVE_AB/BC drives MotorForward only, and DONE lights CompletionLight only.",
      "explanation": "Prevents degenerate implementations that leave MotorForward FALSE in MOVE_* or mirror SensorC in DONE.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
